description: This file defines threading primitives and classes for managing threads, mutexes, condition variables, and asynchronous operations using SDL's threading interface, specifically for the Battle for Wesnoth project.

classes.name: manager
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of threading resources.

classes.name: thread
classes.description: Represents a thread, allowing creation, killing, joining, and detaching.

classes.name: mutex
classes.description: Implements a binary mutex for thread synchronization.

classes.name: lock
classes.description: RAII lock object for mutexes, ensuring mutex is locked/unlocked properly.

classes.name: condition
classes.description: Implements condition variables for thread synchronization.

classes.name: waiter
classes.description: Interface for waiting on asynchronous operations.

classes.name: async_operation
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous operation with execution and notification capabilities.

classes.name: async_operation_holder
classes.description: Manages the lifetime of an async_operation object.

methods.name: thread::thread
methods.description: Constructs a new thread that starts executing a function.

methods.name: thread::~thread
methods.description: Destructor that waits for the thread to finish.

methods.name: thread::kill
methods.description: Terminates the thread if it is running.

methods.name: thread::join
methods.description: Waits for the thread to complete execution.

methods.name: thread::detach
methods.description: Detaches the thread, allowing it to run independently.

methods.name: condition::wait
methods.description: Waits on the condition variable with a mutex.

methods.name: condition::wait_timeout
methods.description: Waits with a timeout on the condition variable.

methods.name: condition::notify_one
methods.description: Wakes one thread waiting on the condition.

methods.name: condition::notify_all
methods.description: Wakes all threads waiting on the condition.

methods.name: async_operation::execute
methods.description: Executes the asynchronous operation, possibly waiting.

methods.name: async_operation::notify_finished
methods.description: Notifies that the operation has finished.

methods.name: async_operation_holder::async_operation_holder
methods.description: Constructs a holder for an async operation.

methods.name: async_operation_holder::~async_operation_holder
methods.description: Deletes the operation if not aborted.
